title: fix(docs): serve llms-full.txt as a static file written at build time, out of Vercel's 20 MB ISR fallback cap
body:
Fixes #23625

Clause-②: no

`/llms-full.txt` is now a static file that `apps/docs/scripts/build-llms-full.mjs` writes into `apps/docs/public/` during the docs build. The prerendered route handler it replaces is gone. The URL, the bytes, the content type and the `X-Robots-Tag: noindex` header all stay the same. What changes is how Vercel receives the file: as a static asset, not as an ISR page. The 20 MB ISR fallback cap was failing every production docs deploy, and it no longer applies to this file.

## What was red (A1)

- `docs-deploy.yml` scheduled runs `38663939159` (01:07Z) and `38695971788` (07:01Z) both failed at step 13, "Deploy the prebuilt output to production". Step 11 (`vercel build --prod`) and step 12 (output assertion) were green, per the run's job steps. The last green run was `38618717424` (2026-10-14 18:51Z).
- The error text was NOT MEASURED here: the job-log download redirects to a blob host that this container's proxy refuses (403 on CONNECT). The card quotes it: `FALLBACK_BODY_TOO_LARGE`, "ISR page llms-full.txt is 20.00 MB, over the 20 MB limit". That string is not in the `vercel@60.1.3` CLI dist (grep). So the check runs server-side, at upload.

## How big, how fast (A3)

To measure, I ran the same generator (`getLLMText` over `source.getPages()`, joined by blank lines) on each commit after `pnpm install` and the docs build's three spec generators (`gen:schema`, `gen:docs`, `gen:upgrade-guide`). That includes the build-time `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/` pages. On `e611e2bda` the result is byte-identical to the route's own prerendered body (below).

| commit (main) | committed | pages | bytes | vs 20,000,000 |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `0d91eaa6e` | 2026-08-25 | 403 | 8,046,416 | -11,953,584 |
| `8c657f7dd` | 2026-09-14 | 402 | 14,632,088 | -5,367,912 |
| `05be35259` | 2026-09-30 | 408 | 16,787,480 | -3,212,520 |
| `51290bca2` | 2026-10-07 | 410 | 17,357,732 | -2,642,268 |
| `989aa483f` (last green deploy) | 2026-10-14 17:58Z | 418 | 19,998,748 | -1,252 |
| `252775d1d` (first red deploy) | 2026-10-15 00:30Z | 418 | 20,004,539 | +4,539 |
| `e611e2bda` (this branch's base) | 2026-10-15 06:55Z | 418 | 20,032,800 | +32,800 |
| `23e689dc7` (main merged in) | 2026-10-15 | 418 | 20,040,773 | +40,773 |

- **The cap is 20,000,000 bytes (decimal MB).** The last green deploy was 1,252 bytes under it and the first red one was 4,539 over. Both print as "20.00 MB".
- **Growth:** 12.0 MB in 50.6 days since 2026-08-25 (1.66 MB/week). The last 30 days averaged 1.25 MB/week; the last 7 days, 2.57 MB/week. The 2026-08-25 figure matches the "8 MB today" that `next.config.mjs` recorded that day.
- **What it is made of** (at `e611e2bda`): the auto-generated `references/**` pages are about 66% of the bytes (`ui` 3.22 MB, `api` 3.06 MB, `data` 2.61 MB, `system` 1.51 MB). The build-time `protocol-upgrade/**` pages are 9.4%. The largest single page is `protocol-upgrade/18`, at 1.46 MB. Growth follows the spec surface, not hand-written docs. So any fix that only trimmed the file back under 20 MB would have failed again within weeks.

## Why a `public/` file escapes the cap (A4)

- I read this from the builder that `vercel@60.1.3` pins, `@vercel/next@15.0.1`. Its `getStaticFiles()` globs `public/**` after the build command and emits each file as a static output. Prerendered routes are emitted as prerenders with a fallback body, and that body is what the deploy API measured. A route handler with `revalidate = false` is a prerender (`.next/server/app/llms-full.txt.body` + `.meta`, `routeCache.kind: APP_ROUTE`).
- After this change the largest prerender in the build is `en/docs/protocol-upgrade/18.html`, at 3,916,137 bytes (19.6% of the cap). Next is `references/api/protocol.html` at 2,422,127.
- **A static-file limit could still apply, and I could not verify it.** vercel.com is unreachable from this container (proxy 403; docs.vercel.com does not resolve). A search-result excerpt of Vercel's limits page gives "Static File uploads 100 MB (Hobby) / 1 GB (Pro)". If 100 MB applies, the file has about 31–64 weeks of headroom at the measured rates. At 1 GB it has years. Before that, the Vercel build and upload never ran here: there is no `VERCEL_TOKEN` in this container.

## The change

- `apps/docs/app/llms-full.txt/route.ts` is deleted, so the file has one producer.
- New `apps/docs/scripts/build-llms-full.mjs`, run by the docs `build` script after the spec generators and before `next build`:
  - It regenerates `.source/` with fumadocs-mdx's own `postInstall()`, which is what `next build` does at config load. On a fresh checkout, `pnpm install` writes `.source/` before `gen:upgrade-guide` creates `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/`, so without this step those three pages (1.87 MB) would be silently missing.
  - It imports `lib/source.ts` as plain Node, so the text comes from the same `getLLMText` and `source.getPages()` the other agent-reader routes use, not from a copy. fumadocs-mdx's Node loader (`fumadocs-mdx/node` `register()`) compiles each page with the same `source.config.ts`.
  - It writes `public/llms-full.txt` and prints `N pages, B bytes`.
  - It exits non-zero on 0 pages, or on a Node without type stripping (`process.features.typescript`, Node 22.18+), so the build fails rather than deploying without the file.
- New `apps/docs/scripts/llms-full/resolve-hooks.mjs`: the Node spelling of the resolutions the Next build already performs. These are the two tsconfig `paths` aliases, plus bare imports from `content/**` resolved from the app, the same reason `turbopack.resolveAlias` exists.
- `apps/docs/.gitignore` ignores `/public/llms-full.txt`.
- A `next.config.mjs` comment now gives the current size and says the noindex header covers the static file.
- `docs-deploy.yml`, `vercel.json` and `turbo.json` are untouched. No bypass flag.

## Proof that this changes delivery only

- **On `e611e2bda`:** the route's prerendered body was 20,032,800 bytes, sha256 `cbbf6f782618778397483dcbea544cc1bc1c144d002e409807e7d2bae1986d0b`. The generator, reading the `.source/` that same build left behind, produced the same sha256.
- **On this branch** (`40af08370`), I ran `apps/docs/vercel.json`'s `buildCommand` from a fresh-checkout state: no `.next`, `.source/` regenerated without `protocol-upgrade`, `protocol-upgrade/` deleted. It succeeded (turbo: 2 tasks, 0 cached). The build printed `build-llms-full: 418 pages, 20,032,800 bytes`, and the route table no longer lists `/llms-full.txt`.
- **Same content, possibly different page order.** A proof script split the file against the 418 per-page bodies Next prerendered in that same build (`/llms.mdx/docs/**`, each one `getLLMText(page)`) and the order `llms.txt` lists them in. Result: `PERMUTATION-EQUAL: 418/418 pages consumed`. The `e611e2bda` route body is also `PERMUTATION-EQUAL` against them. A one-byte mutant of it fails (`FAIL at offset 9886232`). I reran this on `d777181db` with the same result.
- **Page order already varied before this PR.** fumadocs-mdx writes the `.source/` index in a different order on every run: four runs of `fumadocs-mdx` on one tree gave four different index hashes. So the route's page order already changed from build to build. One difference within a single build: this file's order no longer matches `/llms.txt`'s, because the generator and `next build` each regenerate `.source/`. Neither file's order was ever stable, and nothing reads it.
- **Served:** I ran `next start` on that build and fetched `GET /llms-full.txt`. Response: `200`, `Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8`, `X-Robots-Tag: noindex`, `Content-Length: 20032800`, bytes `cmp`-equal to `public/llms-full.txt`. `/llms.txt` and `/docs/ai/agents.mdx` still answer 200. The old route answered `text/plain;charset=UTF-8` with the same header.

## What this PR can and cannot prove

- **It proves:** the build writes the file and fails if it cannot; no prerender above 3.9 MB remains; the local production server serves the file with the same headers.
- **It cannot prove** that Vercel accepts the upload. The card's Done criterion is a green scheduled `docs-deploy.yml` run serving `/llms-full.txt`, and that run happens after merge: the next run is at :43 past 00/06/12/18 UTC, or sooner via the workflow's "Run workflow" button.

## Tests and gates (head `f7ce0ddb6`: this branch with `origin/main` `23e689dc7` merged in)

- At `f7ce0ddb6`, after `pnpm install` and the three spec generators: `node scripts/build-llms-full.mjs` printed `418 pages, 20,040,773 bytes`, and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/docs typecheck` (`fumadocs-mdx && next typegen && tsc --noEmit`) exited 0. The app has no test script. `tsconfig.json` includes `**/*.ts(x)` only, so the two new `.mjs` scripts are outside tsc. The build and the proofs above are their tests.
- At `f7ce0ddb6`, `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 38 commands. All exited 0 (the same 38 also exited 0 at `d777181db`, before the merge), and the `--ran` reconciliation with exit codes says "38 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". The list includes `check:llms-txt`, `check-doc-frontmatter`, `check-docs-nav-label` (+ self-tests), `check:docs-locale-catch-all`, `check:published-files`, `check:turbo-task-graph`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:watch-hint-literal` and `check-undeclared-dep-imports`.
- **A5:** `check:llms-txt` reads `packages/spec/llms.txt` (its `TARGET`), the hand-kept summary inside the spec tarball, not the docs site's `/llms.txt` or `/llms-full.txt`. It is unaffected and green.
- `Build Docs` (ci.yml) runs this same `vercel.json` command on the PR. That check-run is the CI half of the build proof.
- No changeset: `@objectstack/docs` is `private: true` and publishes nothing, so this PR takes `skip-changeset`.

## Acceptance notes

- **`next dev`** no longer serves `/llms-full.txt` until a build, or `node scripts/build-llms-full.mjs` in `apps/docs`, has written the file. The old route rendered it on demand in dev. Production is unaffected.
- **Build time:** the generator compiles every page in Node. That took 81–110 s on a shared 4-core container; `next build` alone took 208 s there.
- **Turbo outputs:** `turbo.json`'s `@objectstack/docs#build` does not list `public/llms-full.txt` among its outputs. A cache-hit replay would restore `.next/**` without the file. Neither production path can replay: `docs-deploy.yml` and the Build Docs gate both set `TURBO_FORCE`, and the deploy runner has no turbo cache. I left the edit out because `turbo.json` is outside this card's claimed file surface. Owner: none.
- **The next prerender to watch** for the same cap is `/docs/protocol-upgrade/18`, at 3.9 MB of HTML. Its source page grows with every 18.x upgrade entry. Owner: none.
